skills.title: Rota Sync
skills.description: Keeps a shared staff rota in one place so shift swaps, cover requests and overtime all settle against the same live schedule.

skills.title: Lane Finder
skills.description: Finds the cheapest viable freight lane for a shipment across contracted carriers and explains why it picked that one.

skills.title: Shift Pay
skills.description: Turns an approved week of shifts into a payroll-ready breakdown with breaks, premiums and overtime already reconciled.
